structured.feedback: The description is about 240 words in Markdown, under the 300 limit, with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing, and it leaves out the dark-shade, eye-irritation, lid and settling-in-lines complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split and that it doesn't use the reviews' praise, such as the shine control and the container.
